ADDCOLUMNS (
    CALENDAR ( DATE("2026","01","01"), TODAY() ),

    "DATE_INTEGER", FORMAT ( [Date], "YYYYMMDD" ),
    "DATE_NUMBER", FORMAT ( [Date], "DD" ),
    "MONTH_YEAR", FORMAT ( [Date], "MMM YYYY" ),
    "MON_YEAR", FORMAT([Date], "MMM") & "'" & FORMAT([Date], "yy"),
    "MON_YEAR_WEEK",
VAR FirstDayOfMonth =
    DATE(YEAR([Date]), MONTH([Date]), 1)
VAR Offset =
    WEEKDAY(FirstDayOfMonth, 2) - 1
VAR WeekNo =
    INT((DAY([Date]) + Offset - 1) / 7) + 1
RETURN
    FORMAT([Date], "MMM") & "'" & FORMAT([Date], "yy") & " - W" & WeekNo
    ,
    "MONTH_INTEGER", FORMAT ( [Date], "MM" ),
    "MONTH", FORMAT ( [Date], "MMM" ),
    "MONTH_YEAR_INTEGER", FORMAT ( [Date], "YYYYMM" ),
    "QUARTER", "Q" & FORMAT ( [Date], "Q" ),
    "QUARTER_YEAR", "Q" & FORMAT ( [Date], "Q YYYY" ),
    "QUARTER_YEAR_INTEGER", FORMAT ( [Date], "YYYYQ" ),
    "YEAR", FORMAT ( [Date], "YYYY" ),

    "FINANCIAL_YEAR",
        "FY "
            & IF ( MONTH ( [Date] ) >= 4, YEAR ( [Date] ), YEAR ( [Date] ) - 1 )
            & "-"
            & RIGHT (
                FORMAT (
                    IF ( MONTH ( [Date] ) >= 4, YEAR ( [Date] ) + 1, YEAR ( [Date] ) ),
                    "0000"
                ),
                2
            ),

    "FINANCIAL_YEAR_SORT",
        IF (
            MONTH ( [Date] ) >= 4,
            YEAR ( [Date] ),
            YEAR ( [Date] ) - 1
        ),

    /* Week Number (Monday = first day) */
    "WEEK_NUMBER", WEEKNUM ( [Date], 2 ),

    /* Week 1, Week 2, ... */
    "WEEK_NAME", "Week " & WEEKNUM ( [Date], 2 ),

    /* Week of Month */
    "WEEK_OF_MONTH",
VAR FirstDayOfMonth =
    DATE(YEAR([Date]), MONTH([Date]), 1)
VAR Offset =
    WEEKDAY(FirstDayOfMonth, 2) - 1     -- Monday = 1
RETURN
"Week "
    & INT((DAY([Date]) + Offset - 1) / 7) + 1,
    "WEEK_OF_MONTH_NO",
VAR FirstDayOfMonth =
    DATE(YEAR([Date]), MONTH([Date]), 1)
VAR Offset =
    WEEKDAY(FirstDayOfMonth, 2) - 1
RETURN
    INT((DAY([Date]) + Offset - 1) / 7) + 1,
    "MON_WEEK_OF_MONTH", FORMAT ( [Date], "MMM" ) & " W" & ROUNDUP ( DAY ( [Date] ) / 7, 0 ),
    "MON_WEEK_OF_MONTH_SORT",
MONTH([Date]) * 10 + ROUNDUP(DAY([Date]) / 7, 0),

    /* Year-Week */
    "YEAR_WEEK",
        FORMAT ( [Date], "YYYY" ) & "-W" &
        FORMAT ( WEEKNUM ( [Date], 2 ), "00" ),

    /* Week Start (Monday) */
    "WEEK_START",
        [Date] - WEEKDAY ( [Date], 2 ) + 1,

    /* Week End (Sunday) */
    "WEEK_END",
        [Date] - WEEKDAY ( [Date], 2 ) + 7
)
